original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: D-local H1 relaxation: complete zero-frame target-feedback prefix substitution, and exact restricted/unrestricted unit-cost single-source XOR minima for all binary K with 1 <= helpers, targets <= 3, no extra registers and arbitrary dirty inputs.
scope_change_reason: Pending PR1194 already treats the original H2/K contract on a fixed word while retaining H1 inside D. This tests the necessity and local price of that retained restriction only inside a fully restored, source-free, common-zero-frame prefix; continuation H1/H3 and projected cleanup remain unchanged.
bottleneck_link: A legal shorter D could reduce scalar ADDs, but physical precision, hosting and the complete paid recursive profile would still need verification. The exact 3-by-3 census finds no gate-count gain from feedback, so this domain cannot supply that improvement. No new kappa or physical supplier is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop this domain once every labeled K has an attained optimum and exact shorter-word exclusion; if radius seven is insufficient, report exact achieved coverage without a minimum claim. Resume target 2026-10-13T22:55:00Z, hard stop 2026-10-13T23:25:00Z; reserve the final quarter for verification and handoff.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 682 maps, including all 512 three-by-three K in 36 permutation orbits; minimum histogram [1,9,36,84,126,132,96,28], maximum 7, zero feedback gains. Packed-row exhaustive MITM and a code-disjoint labeled truth-table replay agree; ordinary full-group BFS controls cover H,T <= 2. README supplies the conditional prefix-substitution proof. Two positive and eight negative semantic/search controls.
